semantics.alias_rule: delegates to the canonical acos owner and returns fresh storage
semantics.shape_rule: preserves every input dimension including empty dimensions
semantics.numeric_rule: IEEE acos with NaN outside the closed unit interval
semantics.tolerance: one ULP against the pinned fixture
semantics.cancellation_points: before delegation, during canonical traversal, and before publication
semantics.vjp_rule: negative upstream gradient divided by square root of one minus input squared
semantics.jvp_rule: the same derivative applied to the input tangent
